fkB2b.techIntro: The parameters apply to all three photo booths — SPOGULIS, OZOLS and INSTAGRAM.
fkB2b.techZoneV: 2 × 3 m of free space for photos
fkB2b.techExtV: We provide a 25 m extension cable
fkB2b.techWeightV:
OZOLS and INSTAGRAM — 60 kg
SPOGULIS — 120 kg
fkB2b.techNetV: Required for the AI photo booth. If there is no Wi-Fi on site, we provide our own.
fkB2b.warnText: SPOGULIS weighs 120 kg. If the event is on the second floor or higher, a lift is required. Please warn us in advance about any stairs on the access route — it affects logistics planning and the number of people needed.
fkB2b.coordTitle: What we agree before the event
fkB2b.coordIntro: For a smooth setup, we agree on the following before the event:
fkB2b.coord1Text: Driveway, entrance and route to the setup location.
fkB2b.coord2Text: An on-site contact who knows the schedule and can show the location. A phone number is required.
fkB2b.coord3Text: We arrive 40–60 minutes before the agreed start. Setup takes 30–40 minutes, teardown 20–30 minutes. We agree when we may set up, when to pack up, and whether there is downtime between setup and the event start.
fkB2b.coord4Text: Whether equipment may be left on site before or after the event.
fkB2b.coord5Text: Internal rules of shopping centres, office buildings and large events — load-in times, passes, security requirements. Please inform us in advance so we can plan logistics.
fkB2b.brandingText: Prints with your logo and a screen in your company colours. We prepare a visual example on request.
fkB2b.docsText: Contract and VAT invoice. Deferred payment and payment term by agreement. SIA "AR DIMANTI" is a VAT payer.
fkB2b.priceText: Photo booths from €220, AI photo feature +€100. We prepare an exact offer with VAT and delivery on request.
fkB2b.a1: About 2×2 m for the booth plus a little extra room for the assistant and props.
fkB2b.a2: Usually 30–45 minutes; we arrive in good time before the event starts.
fkB2b.q3: Does it work indoors without windows?
fkB2b.a3: Yes. Only a 220V socket is needed — the booth provides its own lighting.
fkB2b.q4: How long is the digital gallery available?
fkB2b.a4: We hand over the gallery after the event; it stays available for download long-term.
fkB2b.a5: By VAT invoice, with deferred payment for companies and institutions by agreement.
fkB2b.q6: How far in advance to book for the Christmas season?
fkB2b.a6: December is busy — we recommend booking 3–6 weeks ahead.
fkB2b.ctaText: Describe your event — we will reply with a detailed offer within 1 business day.
